user.title: SondeHub radiosondes
user.description: Pick the location to watch (defaults to your Home Assistant location).

data_description.flight_radius_km: A sonde flying within this distance turns on Sonde nearby and fires sondehub_sonde_nearby (once per sonde).
data_description.landing_radius_km: A landing predicted within this distance turns on Landing nearby and fires sondehub_landing_nearby (once per sonde).
data_description.watch_radius_km: Sondes within this distance are tracked and get a landing prediction.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two position requests (/sondes). Default 300 s = 12 requests per hour.
data_description.prediction_interval: Seconds between two landing prediction requests (/predictions, one request for all sondes). Only sent while sondes are in the watch radius.

init.title: SondeHub radiosondes
init.description: SondeHub is a free community service that asks clients not to poll its API often. Every update costs one request, plus one for landing predictions when they are due. You can also turn off automatic polling (integration menu → System options) and use the Check now button instead.
